# Vendored dependencies

- `three.module.js` — Three.js r160 build (MIT). **Not tracked in git** (1.3 MB);
  restore it with `bash scripts/fetch-vendor.sh`. The live deployment ships it.
- `RoomEnvironment.js` — three.js examples environment scene (MIT, r160).
- `RoundedBoxGeometry.js` — three.js examples geometry helper (MIT, r160).
